shots.prompt: A SPARSE FOREGROUND FRAME overlay for a top-down 2D game screen, 16:9. Draw it EXACTLY in the style of the reference images: thick dark hand-inked outline, flat muted earthy colours with one soft shadow tone, slightly grimy moss texture, simple shapes, NOT detailed, NOT painterly. Only a FEW elements, all hugging the very edges and corners, everything else empty: one fern bunch in the bottom-left corner, one mossy rock in the bottom-right corner, a single root curling down from the top-left corner. Nothing else. Keep the elements small (none reaches more than 15% into the screen from its edge). EVERYTHING that is not one of those elements - the whole centre and the empty parts of the edges - must be ONE flat pure bright green #00FF00 (chroma key), no shading, no texture, no shadow on it. No characters, no text, no UI.
